messages:
Nadia - Alliances: Quick thread: EdgeForce wants to co-sell on EdgeBox hardware + Redwood Private for Polaris Energy. Need crediting rules, CRM mapping, and marketplace co-listing cadence.
Tom - Sales: Polaris is an existing account with an old pilot ticket. We need to avoid double-claiming.
Ellen (EdgeForce SI): From our side: if EdgeForce introduced, we expect 33% first-year booking credit; if joint AE+SI close, then 12%. If EdgeForce supplies hardware, add extra 8% hardware credit.
Nadia - Alliances: Noted. Propose bands: introduced 30%, joint 12%, hardware-supplier bonus +8% (capped at 40%). POC-run by SI = 40% base + hw bonus if they also provide devices.
Samira - Product: For Private deployments, we need ARM-based firmware approvals and an on-site security review before SI runs POC. That changes timelines.
Diego - Legal: add legal gate: account.restricted or gov_tagged require NDAs + 7bd legal signoff before co-marketing.
Tom - Sales: CRM edge-case: Polaris has owner = field.AE_old. EdgeForce opened opportunity via partner portal last week. What wins?
Nadia - Alliances: Rule: timestamp wins for intro if portal submission < first AE outreach. If AE already logged outreach, route to co-sell-review queue.
Ellen (EdgeForce SI): Can we add a claim TTL? We ask for 10 business days for AE to respond after our intro; otherwise EdgeForce can move to qualified.
Tom - Sales: 7bd seems more workable for AEs; let's do 7bd AE action window, 48h SI ack after intake.
PartnerBot: auto: partner-intake ticket PT-80204 created for Polaris / EdgeForce. Captured portal_ts=1829989000.
Nadia - Alliances: CRM mapping pseudo-code (for Platform):
```
acct = find_account_by_domain(contact.email)
if acct and acct.owner != si.owner:
  create_subop(type='si_collab', partner=si.id, tags=['si:EdgeForce'])
  queue='co-sell-review'
elif portal.submission_ts < ae.first_outreach_ts:
  opp.partner_role='introduced'
else:
  opp.partner_role='joint'
```
Samira - Product: Also add account.flags: hardware_approved (bool), requires_fw_review (bool). If requires_fw_review==true -> block SI POC until fw_review_complete.
Diego - Legal: add opp fields: partner_po (string), partner_msa_signed_at (ts). Marketing embargo: 8 business days notice for joint announcement + legal signoff.
FinanceBot: auto: require fields partner_credit_pct (number), partner_credit_basis (introduced|joint|poc_lead|hw_supplier), partner_split_locked_at_stage (string). Finance will block commission calc if missing.
Ellen (EdgeForce SI): Nice. For hardware credit, how to prove supply? We'll upload shipment docs + invoice to the ticket.
Nadia - Alliances: Action: PartnerBot to capture uploaded docs and set hw_credit_pending until Finance verifies.
PartnerBot: auto: PT-80204 updated by Ellen (EdgeForce SI) 1: POC scope + shipment_estimate uploaded.
Tom - Sales: QA: if sub-opportunity created, does it inherit the original ACV? We should keep ACV canonical on parent opp and a subop ACV estimate field.
Nadia - Alliances: yes: parent.acv remains canonical. subop.estimate_acv (number) for tracking partner contribution. Finance: final split applies on parent ACV at Closed Won using partner_credit_pct.
Samira - Product: For marketplace listing: need 1) co-branded one-pager, 2) technical manifest for hardware, 3) deployment notes for Private. Marketing needs 4 business days after SI ack to review.
Diego - Legal: note: do not include customer name in public collateral until Polaris signs off. embargo applies.
Ellen (EdgeForce SI): We'll ack PT-80204 within 24h and upload the POC runbook + hardware manifest.
Tom - Sales: I'll log AE outreach timestamps on the opp so automations can compute wins.
Nadia - Alliances: Final summary: 1) Crediting bands: introduced 30%, joint 12%, SI POC lead 40%, hardware +8% bonus (cap 40%). 2) Claim windows: AE 7bd, SI ack 48h. 3) CRM mapping: create subop for existing-account handoffs per pseudo-code. 4) Fields required: partner_credit_pct, partner_credit_basis, partner_po, partner_msa_signed_at, partner_split_locked_at_stage, hw_credit_pending. 5) Legal: embargo 8bd for joint announcements + signoff for restricted accounts. 6) Product gates: firmware/security review blocks SI POC. 7) Marketplace items: 1-pgr + manifest + deployment notes, marketing review 4bd.
FinanceBot: auto: PT-80204 queued for finance verification of hw_credit when documents are uploaded.
Nadia - Alliances: I'll update the SI playbook with these rules and drop a short PRD in Confluence. Thanks everyone :handshake:
